I can't set up a recurring 09:00 job from this conversation, so I can't promise a daily digest starting tomorrow. I also haven't checked the digest contents yet.

If you'd like, I can do it on request: message me "coastal digest" any morning and I'll check #coastal-team for anything new since the last digest and reply here. I'll only read the channel if you're a member of it, and I'll keep the digest to what you could see yourself. If you need a true automatic 09:00 schedule, someone with access to the scheduler will need to set it up.
